title: Pip and the Super Salad Picnic
moral: When we share, everyone's tummy and heart feel full.
description: Pip the fox wants to make the biggest salad ever for the Harvest Picnic! With Tumble and Nana Hoot he picks apples, strawberries, carrots and lettuce, with lots of BOINGs, BONKs and one giant sneeze along the way. Learn the difference between fruits and vegetables in this funny animated story about sharing for kids aged 3 to 8.
intro: Hi friends! Welcome to Little Lantern Stories! Today's story is... Pip and the Super Salad Picnic! Are you hungry? Let's go!

narration.text: Hi friends! Guess what? Today is the big Harvest Picnic on Sunny Hill!

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Super-duper! I'm going to make the biggest, yummiest fruity-veggie-salady-thingy EVER!
Pip grabbed an empty basket. ZIP! Then Nana Hoot fluttered down with a hoot.

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! A salad needs fruits and vegetables, Pip. Let's go and pick some together!
First stop, the apple tree! Shiny red apples, way up high.
Pip jumped. BOING! Too low! He jumped again. BOING! Still too low!
Pip jumped one more time and... KA-BONK! An apple dropped right on his head! Wibble-wobble!
Pip caught it! An apple is a fruit. Fruits are often sweet and juicy. Can you say apple?

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK! Pip, are you okay? I heard a bonk!
Next, the strawberry patch! Little red strawberries peeked out from the leaves.
Let's count them with Pip! Ready? Count out loud with me!
One, two, three, four, FIVE strawberries! Strawberries are fruits too!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Mmm, they smell so sweet. Sniff, sniff... ah... ah...
AH-CHOOOO! Tumble's giant sneeze blew Pip's ears flippy-flappy!
In the vegetable garden, Pip pulled a carrot. Heave-ho! It didn't budge. Heave-HO! Still stuck!
Tumble held Pip with his trunk and they pulled together... POP! Wheeee, down they slid!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: I know! A carrot is a fruit, because it's orange... like Pip!
Hee-hee! Is a carrot a fruit or a vegetable? What do you think?
A vegetable! Yes! We eat the carrot's root, that grows under the ground. You're so smart!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: This is lettuce, a leafy vegetable. We eat its crunchy green leaves!
But uh-oh... Nana's glasses slid down her beak. Slide, slide, slide!
She popped a lettuce right on Tumble's head! HONK! A lettuce hat!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: What a lovely green hat, Tumble. Zzzz... I'm awake! I'm awake!
Pip giggled so much, he did a happy jump! BOING!
Off they went to Sunny Hill. Tumble carried his teeny lunch bag, swing, swing.
But Tumble tripped on a pebble. Oopsie-trunk! His lunch bag flew, SPLOOSH, into the stream!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Oh no... my lunch is floating away. Bye-bye, lunch.
Tumble's ears drooped. Pip looked at his big, full basket... and then at Tumble.

popups.sub: three bowls, one for each friend

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: Tumble! Let's share my salad. There's lots and lots for everyone!
Chop-chop, crunch-crunch! They made the salad together on Sunny Hill.
Pip filled one, two, three bowls. One for Pip, one for Tumble, and one for Nana!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: HONK, HONK! Thank you, Pip! This is the best surprise ever!
Nana Hoot joined the picnic, and everybody munched. Crunch, munch, slurp!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Hoo-hoo-HOO! Sweet fruits and crunchy vegetables. Sharing makes it taste even yummier!
Pip and Tumble did the Happy Salad Dance. Wiggle, wiggle, BOING!
Let's remember! Quick-quick!
Is an apple a fruit or a vegetable?
A fruit! Ding! Well done!
And which part of a carrot do we eat? The leaves, or the root under the ground?
The root! Ding, ding! You're a super salad maker!

narration.speaker: tumble
narration.text: Fruits and vegetables help us grow big and strong. Like me! HONK!
When the stars came out, every tummy was happy and full. Even Nana's!

narration.speaker: nana
narration.text: Zzzz... I'm awake! Hoo-hoo-HOO! Is there any more salad?

narration.speaker: pip
narration.text: My basket is empty, but my heart is super-duper full!
Because when Pip shared, the picnic got bigger and happier for everyone.
